title: lint/types: 14,366 no-explicit-any warnings can never red CI — make it an error on packages/types/src, delete the vestigial (schema as any) reads, and type ComponentRendererProps with unknown
body:
## 维护者速读

全仓 `pnpm exec eslint packages/*/src apps/console/src`：7,339 文件，**0 error，16,183 warning**，其中 `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` 14,366（非测试源码 4,457）、`react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` 294、`react-hooks/refs` 201、`no-unused-vars` 200。规则是 `warn` 且无 `--max-warnings`，与 objectui#4806 同一结构：什么都不能让 CI 红。元数据路径上 155 处 `(schema as any).KEY` 读取，逐键核对后几乎全是遗留壳——真被藏住的只有 `rowActionDefs`。196 个注册渲染器 0 个用 `ComponentRendererProps` 泛型，81 份内联 `[key: string]: any` 签名。不做全仓翻转（objectui#8316 已拒），只在发布的授权面上加严。

## Measured (2026-10-24, HEAD 7981384)

- ESLint census (5m26s wall): 7,339 files, 0 errors, 16,183 warnings. `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` 14,366 — in non-test source 4,457: app-shell 1,188, components 415, plugin-detail 376, core 304, plugin-grid 267, fields 257, plugin-form 226, types 213. Also `react-refresh/only-export-components` 863, `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` 294, `react-hooks/refs` 201, `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` 200, `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` 153. `eslint.config.js` sets `'@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any': 'warn'` and no workflow passes `--max-warnings`.
- Text census (non-test, excluding `ui/`): `: any` 2,091, `as any` 1,301, `as unknown as` 170, `@ts-ignore` 0, `@ts-expect-error` 1 real site. Top files by casts: `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` 156, `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 111, `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` 96, `data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 85.
- Metadata path: 155 reads of the shape `(schema|node|view|field|… as any).KEY` — plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx` 33, `ListView.tsx` 27, `ObjectGrid.tsx` 10, `WizardForm.tsx` 8, `action-group.tsx` 8. Checking every key `ListView` reads through the cast against `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: `options`, `kanban`, `tree`, `timeline`, `gantt`, `gallery`, `calendar`, `bulkActionDefs`, `userActions`, `title`, `chart` are all declared; `rowActionDefs` is declared nowhere (read via cast 3 times in ListView, 3 in ObjectGrid, 1 in plugin-view) and has no spec row (spec `view.zod.ts` has `rowActions`, `bulkActions`, `bulkActionDefs`). objectui#11349 already removed the same vestigial casts from `SchemaRenderer`.
- Renderers: `packages/components/src/renderers` has 196 files calling `register`; 0 use the `ComponentRendererProps` generic; 81 declare an inline props type of the shape "schema of X, optional className, index signature to any"; `ComponentRendererProps` itself (`packages/types/src/base.ts`) is an index signature to any by design (#0.1 keeps renderer props tolerant). `PluginScopeImpl.registerComponent(type: string, component: any, meta?: any)` in core.
- tsconfig: `strict: true` everywhere; `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`, `noImplicitOverride` appear in 0 configs; 38 of 40 packages extend the root `tsconfig.json` (`noUnusedLocals: false`), not the tier base — the objectui#4806 gap.

## Recommendation (no new script)

- [ ] Scope `'@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any': 'error'` to `packages/types/src` — the published authoring face — the same way `eslint.config.js` already scopes `consistent-type-assertions: never` to `Registry.ts`; 213 existing sites are the ceiling to burn down (e.g. `complex.ts` `metadata?: any`, `data.ts` `data?: any`). The repo-wide flip stays declined per objectui#8316.
- [ ] Delete the `(schema as any)` reads in `ListView.tsx`, plugin-view `ObjectView.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx`; for `rowActionDefs` decide spec-first (declare on the spec row, or stop reading) per AGENTS #0.1.
- [ ] Change `ComponentRendererProps` and the 81 inline copies from an index signature to any to an index signature to unknown: forwarded keys stay admitted (the SchemaRenderer forward path in AGENTS §9 is untouched) but a renderer must narrow before use. Step 0 is the one-line change plus `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` to count breaks — 未实测.
- [ ] Optional decision box: `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` error count via one `tsc -p` run — 未实测.

Benefit: the published `types` face can no longer grow new `any`; `props.foo.bar` in renderers stops compiling silently; one undeclared metadata read (`rowActionDefs`) gets a contract.

Refs: objectui#4806, objectui#11349, objectui#8316, objectui#8347.

Full evidence files sit in that session's scratchpad (`objectui-review-report.md`, `findings-*.md`). ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.
